review: Zwei Gregor is a tank that unfortunately doesn't really shine much as the other tanks in this game in terms of damage and tankiness, but is still reliable enough to be used when you don't have many other tanking options. He enhances the survivability for the entire team and can effectively tank nuke attacks like Talisman Doll's big nuke attack. He is also exceptionally versatile.
